sanskrit_verse:
गणद्रव्यं हरेद् यस् तु संविदं लङ्घयेच् च यः ।
सर्वस्वहरणं कृत्वा तं राष्ट्राद् विप्रवासयेत् ॥
transliteration: gaṇadravyaṃ hared yas tu saṃvidaṃ laṅghayec ca yaḥ | sarvasvaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ rāṣṭrād vipravāsayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who seizes collective property and violates established covenant, having committed total dispossession, shall be expelled from the nation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the protection of collective welfare
Causation arises from violation of consensual dharma
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by impact on societal integrity
Restoration logic demands removal of disruptive elements without infliction of harm
Consciousness alignment requires purification of national space
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent appropriates communal assets AND breaches ratified agreement THEN initiate expulsion protocol
IF act results in complete loss of resources for community THEN classify as sarvasvaharaṇa
IF classified as sarvasvaharaṇa THEN execute vipravāsa with no punitive overlay
ENSURE all enforcement actions maintain non-retaliatory intent
RESTORE social order through exclusion, not degradation
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold where gross violation of public trust mandates immediate separation from state jurisdiction. The court must recognize that retention of such individuals undermines constitutional consciousness and national coherence. Responsibility is measured not by intent but by systemic disruption caused.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This provision aligns with Nyaya through pramāṇa-based recognition of irreversible societal harm. It follows anupūrvaśaḥ — sequential manifestation of disorder due to unchecked appropriation. Responsibility is proportional to the collapse of shared integrity. Punishment is absent; realignment occurs via conscious distancing from contaminating influence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process for violated agreements
Facilitate assumption of responsibility through formal acknowledgment
Restore affected collectives through compensatory alignment
Reintegrate displaced consciousness through guided departure
Purify national field through ritualized exclusion
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. Expulsion proceeds not as punishment but as purification. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
